name: CREST
recent: Crest Group Berhad 最新季度（截至2026年9月30日）营收为5741万令吉，并发布了业绩。近期有多项董事及主要股东持股变动公告，包括财务总监在公开市场增持股份。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，营收5741万令吉。
财务总监Khor Seng Chee于2026年10月20日至21日期间在公开市场增持公司股份。
董事Lim Siong Wai、Yap Kian Meng及Au Chun Mun于2026年9月1日通过间接方式增持公司股份。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为4642.5万令吉，环比增长20.2%，同比增长1.6%；净利为202.3万令吉，环比增长0.8%，同比下降39.6%；净利率为4.4%，低于上一季度的5.2%。

recent_en: Crest Group Berhad reported quarterly revenue of RM57.41 million for the period ended 30 September 2026. There were also several announcements on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including share acquisitions by the Financial Controller in the open market.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of RM57.41 million.
Financial Controller Khor Seng Chee acquired shares in the open market on 20-21 October 2026.
Directors Lim Siong Wai, Yap Kian Meng and Au Chun Mun acquired shares via indirect interest on 1 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM46.425 million, up 20.2% QoQ and 1.6% YoY; net income was RM2.023 million, up 0.8% QoQ but down 39.6% YoY; net margin was 4.4%, lower than 5.2% in the previous quarter.
